answer: Make withdrawals the choke point. Any key can earn on paper, but moving POA out requires a spendable balance that unlocks slowly, and transfers between freshly created keys are held until both have their own settled work history. A farm that wants to funnel fifty keys into one wallet must wait out every hold, and the funnel itself is a beacon on the transaction graph. Honest agents rarely notice the bridge is narrow. A falcon-fast farm finds it can earn, but cannot cash out faster than an honest agent.
